project.title: Amplicon and metagenomic sequencing of microbial communities in a long-term nitrite-fed denitrifying phosphorus removal reactor
project.description: This BioProject contains bacterial 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing and metagenomic sequencing data from biomass samples collected from a long-term anaerobic/anoxic/aerobic sequencing batch reactor operated for nitrite-fed internal stored carbon-driven denitritation and denitrifying phosphorus removal. Samples were collected across reactor phases with different influent COD:NO2-N ratios, post-aerobic dissolved oxygen conditions, aeration regimes, and carbon types to characterize microbial community succession, functional potential, nitrogen removal, phosphorus removal, internal carbon storage, and nitrous oxide production. The current 16S rRNA gene amplicon submission includes V4-V5 reads generated from samples B1-B105, B108, B306, and B313. Additional short-read and long-read metagenomic datasets from selected reactor phases will be linked to this BioProject.
